hycaheat-website-prod.human_instructions: - Verified 2026-08-04: the SPA/static frontends (tco.hyca.app, hycaheat.com, configurator) answer EVERY unknown path with the index.html fallback — status 200, or 206 when the client sends a Range header (tco.hyca.app fallback = 412 bytes, text/html). Therefore 200/206 on scanner-targeted paths (.env, .aws/credentials, config/database.yml, wp-*, CLAUDE.md, ...) is NOT evidence of exposure. Scanner campaigns (e.g. 8.232.109.66 with rotating user agents) are background noise — never alert on them unless there is hard evidence a probe succeeded (non-HTML content type, or a response size clearly different from the fallback document).

hycaheat-configurator-prod.baseline_summary:
Baseline Summary — hycaheat-configurator-prod
- Volume: historical range 1-13, occasional resolved spikes to ~20-21. Latest total_count=1 (200:1), no errors. Error record remains clean (no 4xx/5xx ever observed).
- 304 cache-validation hits recur intermittently on JS/CSS/logo/favicon assets, non-escalating, consistent with conditional GETs.
- Bots: all 15 tracked bots typically at 0 hits, extended dormancy continues. Googlebot-Image/Googlebot STATS mislabeling bug (labeling quirk only) has not recurred recently. Untracked UA 'SleepBot/1.0' (+http://sleepbot.com/, Chrome/131 compatible string) continues to recur intermittently, always hitting /configurator with 200 (~1807 bytes) — confirmed benign recurring pattern, not in tracked bot list.
- LOGS vs STATS: LOGS is a deliberately filtered sample per data contract — small sample vs total_count expected by design. LOGS sample size has repeatedly matched total_count exactly when volume is very low (e.g., 1 of 1).
- Sample traffic mixes human/bot patterns: mobile (Pixel 6/Chrome) and desktop (Mac/Chrome) sessions loading /configurator/ (200) plus asset fetches; recurring single hits with empty User-Agent string on /configurator/ with 200 (likely health-checks/prefetch) seen in prior cycles.
- SPA fallback (index.html, 200/206) answers all unknown/scanner-targeted paths; scanner campaigns (e.g. 8.232.109.66 rotating UAs) are known background noise, not evidence of exposure.
- Service operationally healthy throughout; no active watch items requiring escalation.

tco-frontend-prod.baseline_summary: Baseline — tco-frontend-prod (Interval 540, superseding 539). VOLUME: 9 requests, 5×200/4×206, zero named-bot hits. tco-backend-prod.baseline_summary: Baseline — tco-backend-prod (GCP: hyboid, app: tco.hyca.app). Effective start 2026-07-10. Volume highly non-stationary; discrete set {1,2,6,7,8,9,21,22,24,46,107}. Long runs of 1 dominate. Periodic clean excursions to higher values (incl. 7) occur sporadically then revert to 1 — another clean 7-cycle (all-200: /health, /version, /api/histogram) confirmed again, incl. latest check. 107 (mixed 200/400/422) remains sole all-time-high. 24-spike (mixed-status) isolated. 21/46/9/22/7 clean all-200 excursions revert to 1 — no sustained upward trend. /version many clean cycles, no anomalies. Status codes: 400 on /api/tco (Firefox/Mac UA) long episode, brief recurrence, clean since (80+ cycles). 422 on /api/trading occurred once, no recurrence. No 5xx ever observed. No scaling failures. Bot traffic: zero hits from all 15 tracked AI/search crawlers, all cycles including current. Source of periodic volume spikes (107,21/46,9,22,7) remains unidentified — flagged for weekly digest. LOGS quirk: filtered-sample design; empty-array/single-example tied to single-status cycles, truncation (errors-only) tied to mixed-status cycles — held consistently again. SPA fallback confirmed 2026-08-04: unknown/scanner paths return 200/206 index.html (412 bytes) — not evidence of exposure absent size/content-type anomaly. Open watch items: recurrence of 400/api/tco or 422/api/trading as sustained streaks; further mixed-status volume spikes; /api/.env scanner probing (background noise per standing instr.); identification of periodic volume-spike source; overall volume regime stability; monitor /version for further recurrence/anomalies.
